text:
sam: quick alert — morning CI SAST run for service-auth shows a cluster of new unverified findings. evidence attachments missing for several files.
nina: any recent RBAC or key rotations? we did a scoped keystore remodel last night for compliance.
frank: I rotated the upload-key as part of the keystore hardening (moved to envelope encryption and rotated key versions). I replaced one legacy project-level binding with a key-level binding and added a new service account 'sa-evidence@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com'.
sam: paste from uploader log:
```
2026-06-10T05:12:08Z ERROR evidence-uploader: upload verify failed: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=\"cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt permission denied\"
artifact: evidence omitted
```
scan-bot: nightly-sast v5.1.0 completed. Findings: 87 (+72). Missing attachments: [PR#7890, PR#7894]. KMS errors: DataAccess status.code=7 x2, and 16 x1.
olga: 16 is Unauthenticated — do we have a mismatch between workload identity vs service account email binding? or did the envelope config change expected principal names?
frank: I used the envelope workflow which expects the uploader to call KMS via a short-lived key decrypt step with the workload identity token. I accidentally left the binding to the old serviceAccount email rather than the workload identity member.
nina: ok immediate plan: 1) add a temporary key-scoped binding for the current caller identity so evidence reuploads succeed; 2) re-run affected SAST jobs; 3) add a preflight check and a CAB sign-off for any project-/key-level RBAC changes going forward (SOC2 requirement).
sam: agree. Also we should avoid reintroducing broad project roles. Use this TF snippet for the key-level binding with workload identity format:
```
resource \"google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding\" \"evidence_decrypt\" {
  crypto_key_id = \"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/evidence/cryptoKeys/upload-key\"
  role          = \"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter\"
  members       = [\"principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/wip/attribute.repository/infra-sa\"]
}
```
frank: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/801 — adds short-lived key binding and notes envelope config.
scan-bot: created INC-8342: \"SAST evidence missing — KMS binding mismatch after envelope rotation\" assigned to eng-security.
olga: audit question: why did SOC2 monitoring not flag non-zero DataAccess.status.code? Our current alerting only looks for key access volume anomalies, not explicit status codes.
nina: that's a gap. Compliance needs DataAccess non-zero codes to be indexed into our security telemetry and retained for 13 months per policy.
sam: follow-ups: a) extend audit pipeline to ingest KMS DataAccess protoPayload.status.code and principalEmail b) add a Grafana panel and alert rule for non-zero codes for keys in 'evidence' keyring c) add PR preflight GH action to impersonate the uploader identity and perform a mock decrypt d) update RBAC change playbook to require CAB sign-off for changes that touch keys used by evidence stores.
frank: for preflight we can run a GH Action step using impersonation test (returns non-zero on failure):
```
gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=sa-evidence@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com && 
gcloud kms keys decrypt --location=global --keyring=evidence --key=upload-key \
  --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --plaintext-file=/tmp/pt \
  --impersonate-service-account=sa-evidence@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
ops-bot: added task to INC-8342: owners assigned -> frank (infra fix), sam (observability), nina (compliance doc), olga (postmortem). Due date: 2026-06-17.
sam: frank, once you merge the key-level fix, kick manual re-runs and post diffs here. Also please attach evidence that reuploads succeeded for the affected PRs.
frank: merged and applied via terraform at 06:24 UTC. manual-run triggered. Reuploads succeeded, scan diffs show findings dropped to normal. Links: nightly-2026-06-10-hotfix-1.
olga: I'll log this in compliance tracker with the timeline and note the 13-month audit retention gap. We'll need to backfill DataAccess logs for the last 90 days into the security index for SOC2 audit.
nina: thanks team. Action owners: frank (infra fix + infra PR template update), sam (index DataAccess + Grafana alert), olga (audit retention backfill), nina (CAB sign-off flow update).
sam: also adding a short rule to RBAC playbook: any change to project- or key-level KMS bindings must include a preflight test log and a line \"affects evidence pipeline: yes/no\".
frank: note for future: envelope encryption adds extra identity formats — update infra docs to include the exact principal formats we accept.
scan-bot: reactions :thumbsup: from 7 users recorded.
